notes: Predator 3100 PSI, 2.8 GPM gas pressure washer (Harbor Freight item 62214) with a 212 cc engine. The part numbers are the manual's list numbers, not Harbor Freight SKUs; pump list numbers end in A and engine list numbers in B.

gaps: The manual says some listed parts are shown for illustration only and are not sold individually; the lists do not mark which, so the list numbers are not claimed to be orderable parts.
The manual's component picture labels a thermal relief valve and mentions it on page 14, but the parts lists give it no item number, so it is not claimed.
Pump make is not stated in the parts list.
Engine horsepower is not stated, so none is given.
No production years are set: the manual is copyright 2014 and its emissions warranty text mentions a 2017 engine.
Item 56575 (another Predator 3100 PSI unit) was not found; item 62214 is used.
method: Predator 62214 owner's manual and illustrated parts lists, REV 16l (copyright 2014 Harbor Freight Tools, item 62214), copy on apw-inc.com (a parts retailer): specifications page 2, components page 9, general parts list page 24, pump parts list page 26, engine parts list page 28.
manuals.harborfreight.com returned HTTP 404 for the 62214 manual, so the retailer copy was used.

comps.spec: 212 cc horizontal single-cylinder 4-stroke OHV engine, forced-air cooled, 70 x 55 mm bore and stroke, 8.5:1 compression (specifications page); general parts list item 29, qty 1
Axial pump, direct drive, maximum pressure 3100 PSI, flow rate 2.8 GPM. Pump parts list (A suffix) has six check valves, a by-pass jet, a detergent injector, a 3/4 in NH inlet fitting and a filter
Spray gun with trigger, general parts list item 2 (qty 1), with the wand (item 1, qty 1, 21 in long) and the gun holder (item 3, qty 1)
Pressure hose, 25 ft, general parts list item 15 (qty 1)
Five nozzles: red 0 deg, yellow 15 deg, green 25 deg, white 40 deg and black detergent (items 8-1 to 8-5), with five nozzle grommets (item 9)
Detergent tank, general parts list item 24, with lid (item 23) and detergent tube (item 33)
Engine fuel tank, engine parts list item 81B; capacity 0.95 gal (3.6 L) per the specifications
Fuel the engine takes per the specifications: unleaded gasoline, 87 octane or higher, stabilizer treated
Engine oil 0.5 quart (0.5 L): 10W-30 above 32 F, 5W-30 at 32 F or below
Wheel (general parts list item 28, qty 2) and axle (item 22, qty 2)
Frame (general parts list item 13, qty 1) and handle (item 5, qty 1)
Engine oil sensor, engine parts list item 14B (qty 1)
Ignition coil, engine parts list item 105B (qty 1)

sources.title: Predator 62214 3100 PSI gas pressure washer owner's manual and illustrated parts list, REV 16l (copyright 2014 Harbor Freight Tools; item 62214, copy on apw-inc.com)
